scientific_integrity: The general spectral-dark-state method is pre-existing. Only the evaluated weighted-rook resonance classification, capture discontinuity and quadratic survival crossover are proposed as the new contribution. Priority claims require external historical review.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite weighted complete-graph Cartesian factors; exactly one irreversible corner absorber; fixed positive detector strength and hopping scales in the detuning asymptotic. No claims for multiple sinks, disorder, growing volume, or repeated projective measurements. Exact all-size proof plus finite-matrix reproducibility; historical literature examination is not exhaustive.
title: A quarter-loss resonance and quadratic lifetime law for an absorbing weighted rook graph
